t: You're standing at the Empire, a cinema on the north side of Leicester Square, run today by Cineworld. Two theatre architects are named in connection with the building, Thomas Verity and Frank Matcham. Verity worked during the great theatre-building boom between 1885 and 1915. Matcham was far more prolific, responsible for the design of over ninety theatres across the United Kingdom, including London's Hippodrome, the Coliseum and the Palladium. So this is a cinema with real theatre-building pedigree behind it.
